entries.cb38d7fc7dbc7369: A service in which the company uses its server group and proprietary software to perform on behalf of and support companies in preventing information leaks. Centered on managed services that operate and monitor security equipment 24 hours a day, 365 days a year (the SOC is called G-SOC), the company provides Secure Mail Service, Managed Service for EDR (EDR-MSS), Targeted Email Attack Training Service, SIEM Construction and Operation Support Service, and Digital Forensics Service for responding to information leak incidents (Emergency Response Service). The company is certified as a PFI, an investigator of card information leak incidents. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended June 2026 was ¥3,151 million.
